name: Eswatini

system.type: Tinkhundla: individual candidates by constituency; political parties banned
system.elects: 59 elected members of the House of Assembly

wildFacts.text: Political parties are banned from elections; every candidate runs as an individual.
584,710 voters registered, 91.2% of the eligible population.
SADC observers called the vote peaceful and recommended dialogue on the role of political parties.

notes: Absolute monarchy (King Mswati III). No turnout figure was found. There is no national winner: parties are banned and only non-party candidates stand.
